items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: From Companies House: its published company data file, newly incorporated companies, strike-off filing events (DS01 and DS02) and officer records. Coverage depends on what has been loaded so far, and officer data is collected in stages. Nothing is scraped or estimated.

items.q: What does “not fetched” mean for directors?
items.a: Officer data is collected from Companies House in stages. A company whose officers have not been fetched yet is shown as not fetched, never as zero directors, and director filters only evaluate companies with confirmed officer data.
Yes. Any search, filter or saved report can be exported as CSV. Exports follow your filters and are protected against spreadsheet formula injection.
